articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.snippet: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: Trump's Democratic SEC pick suggests tokenization policy deserves full rule process
articles.snippet: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee held a confirmation hearing for the two nominees — one from each party — as the administration rebuilds the markets regulators.

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.snippet: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
articles.snippet: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

articles.title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
articles.snippet: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.
